name: Beixiao Liu
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in New York, New York
side_practice_areas: Business Litigation, Securities & Corporate Finance, Bankruptcy
about: Beixiao Robert Liu is the Managing Partner of the Balance Law Firm in New York, New York, and represents corporations and individuals in legal matters related to financial markets, banking, bankruptcy, employment and labor law, mergers and acquisitions, international economic and trade law, and aviation law, among many others. A Chartered Financial Analyst, he is also well-versed in handling business issues pertaining to capital markets, anti-money laundering, banking and financial regulations, as well as financial technology. He is fluent in Mandarin.

After completing his undergraduate studies in finance from Tsinghua University, Mr. Liu was accepted into the Yale School of Management through the Silver Scholar Program to pursue a higher education. After receiving his MBA in business and management, he went to work for the Promontory Financial Group, part of IBM, where he rose through the ranks to serve in a variety of impactful roles, including advising CEOs of large banks in the United States and China on risk management and corporate governance.

While growing his career at IBM, Mr. Liu simultaneously attended the evening program at the Georgetown University Law Center, receiving his Juris Doctor in international law and legal studies in 2015. Licensed to practice in New York in 2019, he is also licensed to practice in the District of Columbia, Connecticut, Alaska, Washington, Maryland and New Jersey. Additionally, he is admitted to practice before the following courts:
· The United States Court of International Trade
· The United States District Courts for the Southern and Eastern Districts of New York
· The United States District Court for the District of Columbia
· The United States District Court for the District of New Jersey
· The United States Courts of Appeals for the 2nd and 3rd Circuits
· The United States Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit

Outside his law practice, Mr. Liu is a member of the American Bar Association, the New York County Lawyers Association, the CFA Society of New York and the CFA Society of Stamford. An altruistic individual, he volunteers his time to important causes to uplift people who are less privileged than himself. A volunteer with Habitat for Humanity for nearly a decade, he has helped build homes in various neighborhoods in Washington, D.C., in a measure to alleviate poverty.
